knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Screening could change the work, so the restoration price is conditional on the result.
A hazard finding is a stop and a condition, not an upsell. Removal is outside scope unless the business holds the licence.
Approval is a required step before any quote is sent, and it is recorded.

practicalCriteria: Quote shows the assessment and screening as a separate stage
Assumptions, exclusions and price-changing conditions listed
Approval recorded before the quote is sent
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% or higher. With three checks this means all three must be correct. Practical sign-off is separate: every practical criterion must be observed and met by the assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not count toward sign-off.
evidenceRequired: Quote with stages, assumptions and conditions
stopWorkCriteria: Fixed restoration price issued before screening
